name: Jug
description: Deep, positive hold you can wrap your whole hand around

name: Pinch
description: Squeezed between thumb and fingers, usually taller than it is wide

name: Pocket
description: A hole that takes one to three fingers

name: Crimp
description: Thin edge that only fits your fingertips

name: Volume
description: Large bolted-on shape, held by pressing or wrapping an edge

name: Sloper
description: Rounded hold with no edge, held with an open hand and friction

name: Foot chip
description: Tiny hold meant for feet only

name: Not sure
description: Type not known; treated as an average hold
